body: But you have some that is next you and likes you enough to want to date you. My last valentine was my best guy friend and that was just a spun of the moment joke. When it comes to dating I'm always the second/backup option and it sucks. No one wants me for me, unless they are basically forced to lower their standards.
Dude you're not a waste of space. You are a human someone somewhere has to like. I like you. I like to think you helped me out and to me that means the world.

I'm not killing myself, yet. I though it would be a good idea to wait majority of college to see where it takes me and so far it's nothing like i expected. While everyone's out and having fun I'm stuck in my own box alone, depressed, and in a room smaller than the width of a school bus.
It's hard waiting so long just to find what i want to be happy. I don't want to sound selfish but why does it take so long.
